optionAnalysis: the slip the page gives for D (shield on the non-deductible 25%) actually produces 5% − 3.7% × (1 − 0.40 × 0.25) = 1.67%, option A; A's 'taxing the coupon' does not give 1.67% (5% × 0.60 − 3.7% × 0.70 = 0.41%). C's 2.96% comes from 5% − 3.7% × (1 − 0.75 × 0.60) = 2.965%. Appended these recomputed values to optionAnalysis a, c and d. Key B (1.30% + 1.11% = 2.41%) confirmed.

Step 4 said a beta of 1.012 means 'TIPS yields move slightly more than one-for-one with T-bond yields'. With the hedge condition F_TIPS × DV01_TIPS = F_Tbond × DV01_Tbond × β, β is the T-bond yield change per 1 bp change in the TIPS yield (Tuckman's regression of nominal on real yield changes), so it is the nominal yield that moves more. Reworded. Also 0.063 × 1.012 / 0.092 = 0.693 exactly (not 0.692999), and 150 × (0.092/0.063) × 1.012 = 221.676. Appended Errata to optionAnalysis b and c: dividing by β gives 101.50, not 125.37, and no simple slip reproduces 125.37 or 186.95. Key A (103.95) confirmed.

optionAnalysis.d attributed +18.6 to omitting the asset leg (which gives −33.6). 18.6 is exactly the surplus level after the shock with the liability sign flipped (30 − 45 + 33.6). Appended that note. Key B (−45 − 33.6 = −78.6) confirmed.

optionAnalysis.a says the green-zone multiplier gives 4,227 'with variants near 4,185', but 4,227 is option B and no consistent slip gives 4,185; optionAnalysis.d's row-contamination example gives 6,364, not 5,821. Appended Errata notes to both. Key C (max(756, 4 × 544) + max(1,039, 4 × 865) = 2,176 + 3,460 = 5,636) confirmed.
